title: Miss Vinland Saga? New 2027 Anime Confirms Its Release Date & It’s the Next Must-Watch
content: One of the most anticipated anime of 2027 confirmed its release date in a brand new trailer. Since fans of Vinland Saga fans still have no idea when to expect the anime’s third season, this upcoming historical anime will be perfect for fans to watch in the meantime.
author: ComicBook

title: New Live-Action Hana-Kimi Series Unveils More Cast, New Trailer
content: The staff for the new live-action television series based on the late Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) unveiled four more cast members and a new 30-second trailer on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super Secretly Has a King of the Saiyans It Hasn’t Even Used Yet
content: A major aspect that’s yet to get explored in the Dragon Ball multiverse is the only living king of the Saiyans, Universe 6’s Sadala. The Tournament of Power revealed to the Z Fighters that there is an existing Saiyan planet. Goku and Vegeta lost their home world in Universe 7 when Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta .
author: ComicBook

title: Precure Franchise Announces FUNtasic Precure! Anime
content: Toei Animation announced on Thursday that the 24th entry in the Precure franchise has the title FUNtasic Precure! The tagline for the anime is "Shine! Everyone's smiles! Welcome to the FUNtasic party!" The logo features party motifs such as confetti poppers and garlands.
author: ANN

title: Major Shojo Anime Breakout Confirms Season 2 Return With First Look
content: Shojo anime continues to dominate upcoming seasonal anime rotations , with breakout hits like Firefly Wedding becoming viral sensations, as well as fans spinning rumors regarding which new series will be getting a sequel first.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Darkest Sci-Fi Anime of 2026 Is Already a Masterpiece Worthy of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
content: Netflix has released a new dark sci-fi anime with all 12 episodes worthy of replacing Cyberpunk: Edgerunners for your Thanksgiving weekend binge. As an original anime series on Netflix, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners delivers a grim story with social inequality as its central driving force.
author: ComicBook

title: Get Ready for Avengers: Doomsday With This Disney+ Anime No One’s Really Seen
content: Avengers: Doomsday ‘s theatrical debut is rapidly approaching , and for many MCU fans, now is the perfect time to binge watch every film, television show, and press release to try and catch every lore detail or hint as to what’s to come.

title: Pokémon Anime Gets New Season Featuring Liko, Roy in October 2027
content: The Pokémon Company announced on Friday the Pokémon anime will get a new season that will debut in October 2027 and will air on TV Tokyo and its affiliates. The new season will again feature Liko and Roy who will have new encounters and new adventures.
author: ANN

title: 'Kaze wo Tsugumono' Reveals Additional Staff, Second Promo
content: The official website of the Kaze wo Tsugumono ( Inherit the Winds ) original television anime revealed additional staff and the second promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on January 10 at 11:30 p.m. on the Agaru Anime programming block on CBC and TBS' 28 affiliated stations.
author: MyAnimeList
